main_text.l: qvàm antea de ifto Eliezere se sentire
de eo loquebantur, tanqvam homine o-
si dogmatis autore: de Morino enim ita
atque post Simeonis de Muis obitum,
qui ei inimicos Basileae, Lugduni aliisqve
in locis apud Protestantes qvaesierat, ve-
nit in amicitiam Joannis Buxtorfii, qvi a-
mico erga eum esse animo per literas
illi significavit, ad qvas amicè etiam re-
nem plurimi faciens, à qvo etiam in ali-

page.notes: The reference marks are printed as (n) and (o) in the text; they are given here as {n} and {o}, the parentheses being dropped. The word "Halloixio," has a stray mark after the comma in the scan, left out. The "E" below the last line is a gathering signature and "testi-" a catchword. Printed "tanqvam" and "qvàm" are kept as printed. Long s is normalised to s; "Muisio" is read from the printed "Muifio". The top-right page number is read as 73 and may be partly obscured.
